interpretation_notes: The evidence establishes material shortfalls across the normalized proposition. Edmonton reported winter range averaging about 165 km against a contracted 268 km, and warm-weather range reaching at best 250 km against 328 km. City filings also describe recurring outages, body and hardware failures, unreliable software, repair costs, and periods when more than half the fleet was unavailable. Proterra's bankruptcy then disrupted warranty coverage, parts, and vendor support. TTC measurements of comparable Proterra buses independently corroborate poor winter range, below-target reliability, and body cracking. The buses still provide daily service, so the absolute circulating statement that they 'do not work' is too strong, but that does not defeat the narrower normalized proposition of substantial procurement underperformance. Confidence is Moderate because most Edmonton-specific performance figures and failure counts come from the City's untested litigation position rather than an independent fleet audit.
